The '''Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon''' is a dungeon south of the underground city of [[Dorgesh-Kaan]] (notated by an [[Agility]] icon on the map). Entry to the dungeon requires completion of the [[Death to the Dorgeshuun]] quest. The dungeon is [[Darkness|dark]] and requires the player to have a [[light source]] or face relentless damage from stinging insects. A [[tinderbox]] is recommended (to relight the light source, just in case) but is not necessary. An [[antipoison]] potion may also be helpful, as there are several [[poisonous]] creatures in the dungeon.

You can use a [[dwarf multicannon]] in the dungeon, however it is not multicombat.

==Notable features==
*There is a two-way passage between the dungeon and the [[Kalphite Lair]], using the [[blocked tunnel]] and [[tunnel (Kalphite Lair)|tunnel]].
*[[Fairy ring]] {{Fairycode|AJQ}} provides access to the dungeon.
*There are two net fishing locations for [[frog spawn]]. You can also do bait fishing here to obtain [[Raw cave eel|raw cave eels]] and [[Raw slimy eel|raw slimy eels]].
*The [[Dorgesh-Kaan Agility Course]] requires 70 [[Agility]].
